mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1950 thousand units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives economic momentum and supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1950, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1950 and RSAFS > 360000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPIAUCSL above 200.0 combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals accelerating inflation that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200.0 and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.7% and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000 thousand signals a labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE < 4.7 and PAYEMS > 135000 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 11380 billion dollars combined with rising residential investment (HOUST) signals strong economic momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 > 11380 and HOUST > 1950 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
